title: No Country for Old Men — Call It
subtitle: 1980 West Texas Texaco Counter · Two-Hander v2.8: Damon & Zach

setups.NC2_WIDE: Gritty 1980 Roger Deakins 35mm West Texas Texaco general store interior at sun-bleached midday; Zach (brown-bearded gas-station clerk in faded yellow-ochre plaid short-sleeve button-up shirt over white crew tee and tan suspenders) stands on left behind scarred oak checkout counter with sunlit cracked-earth desert plains in the wide glass window behind him and vintage jerky jars beside an old brass cash register; Damon (bald Black man with rectangular black-rimmed glasses and short trimmed beard, dressed in dark navy snap-front work jacket over black cotton tee) stands on right across the counter beside a crinkled foil cashew bag and a single silver quarter on the wood grain; zero other customers inside.
setups.NC2_ZACH_OTS: Shallow f/2.2 35mm OTS past Damon's dark navy work-jacket shoulder in foreground right onto nervous Zach on left behind the oak counter framed against sunlit West Texas desert glass.
setups.NC2_DAMON_OTS: Shallow f/2.2 35mm OTS past Zach's yellow-ochre plaid shoulder & suspender strap in foreground left onto ice-cold deadpan Damon on right framed against sunlit white store doorway and dusty snack shelves.
setups.NC2_ZACH_MCU: Gritty Deakins MCU of bearded Zach framed left-of-center behind the scratched wooden counter beside jerky jars and brass cash register edge under harsh overhead fluorescent and window key light.
setups.NC2_DAMON_MCU: Gritty Deakins MCU of Damon framed right-of-center in dark work jacket against sunlit white paneled door and dusty Texaco pegboard snacks, eyes unwavering across the counter.
setups.NC2_ZACH_CU: Tight intense 35mm CU of Zach framed left, forehead beaded with nervous West Texas heat sweat, staring helplessly down toward the counter coin.
setups.NC2_DAMON_CU: Tight intense 35mm CU of Damon framed right in stark half-shadow beneath overhead store light, razor-cold focus fixed forward.
setups.NC2_CLIMAX_FX: Wide Texaco checkout-counter practical-FX frame starting from clean dry floorboards: Damon holds completely deadpan above the wooden counter on the right as a catastrophic pressurized wave of thick glossy wet dark-brown liquid diarrhea blasts violently from behind his black trousers across the sunlit floorboards onto the lower white door while Zach freezes in shock on the left.
setups.NC2_ZACH_POST: Derived from NC2_ZACH_MCU: pale shell-shocked Zach resting both hands flat on the oak counter beside an upright bright pink bottle of Pepto-Bismol.
setups.NC2_DAMON_POST: Derived from NC2_DAMON_CU: composed, stone-faced Damon with hands completely down out of frame holding cold parting gaze beside the sunlit store door.

shots.speaker: fx
shots.cam: Static wide Texaco counter establishing Zach left behind the register and Damon right beside a silver quarter and cashew bag.

shots.speaker: zach
shots.cam: Locked OTS past Damon's dark shoulder onto polite, awkward Zach behind the register.
shots.dialogue: Cash or pump two, mister? Fair warning though, that roller-grill brisket taco been spinning since Tuesday morning... y'all fixin' to get rain out west?
shots.tts: Cash or pump two, mister? Fair warning though, that roller-grill brisket taco been spinning since Tuesday morning... y'all fixin' to get rain out west?

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Locked OTS past Zach's plaid shoulder onto unblinking Damon.
shots.dialogue: Two forty-nine for the cashews. Why did you ask about the brisket taco? It's none of your business what I ate before my morning Aquabike ride.
shots.tts: Two forty-nine for the cashews. Why did you ask about the brisket taco? It's none of your business what I ate before my morning Aquabike ride.

shots.speaker: zach
shots.cam: MCU on flustered Zach trying to defuse the sudden hostility.
shots.dialogue: Whoa, hey, I didn't mean nothing by it, man. You just grabbed three Imodium packs and two wet naps, so I figured maybe the brisket got you.
shots.tts: Whoa, hey, I didn't mean nothing by it, man. You just grabbed three Imodium packs and two wet naps, so I figured maybe the brisket got you.

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Deadpan locked MCU of Damon across the dusty counter.
shots.dialogue: What time do you close this station? Wait... did you just assume an expired gas-station taco can rattle my core?
shots.tts: What time do you close this station? Wait... did you just assume an expired gas-station taco can rattle my core?

shots.speaker: zach
shots.cam: Locked OTS onto bewildered Zach eyeing the dusty clock behind him.
shots.dialogue: We close at six, round suppertime. Listen, dude, you're sweating straight through a heavy denim shirt at sixty-eight degrees. Take the Pepto.
shots.tts: We close at six, round suppertime. Listen, dude, you're sweating straight through a heavy denim shirt at sixty-eight degrees. Take the Pepto.

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Locked OTS on Damon tilting his chin down calmly toward the counter.
shots.dialogue: You see this 1958 quarter? It's been traveling twenty-two years to get across this counter... right beside three warm brisket tortillas.
shots.tts: You see this 1958 quarter? It's been traveling twenty-two years to get across this counter... right beside three warm brisket tortillas.

shots.speaker: zach
shots.cam: Locked MCU on Zach nervously eyeballing the quarter.
shots.dialogue: Look, man, your stomach just made a sound like a wet carburetor. You don't gotta flip coins—the bathroom key is hanging right next to the jerky.
shots.tts: Look, man, your stomach just made a sound like a wet carburetor. You don't gotta flip coins—the bathroom key is hanging right next to the jerky.

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Tight CU of Damon's icy unblinking intensity.
shots.dialogue: What's the most you ever lost in an Aquabike age-group transition? If you call heads, I walk calmly out that door to my bike rack.
shots.tts: What's the most you ever lost in an Aquabike age-group transition? If you call heads, I walk calmly out that door to my bike rack.

shots.speaker: zach
shots.cam: Tight CU on Zach panicking over what he's being asked to wager.
shots.dialogue: Wait a second... what happens if I call tails?! I ain't mopping aisle four on a Friday afternoon, friendo!
shots.tts: Wait a second... what happens if I call tails?! I ain't mopping aisle four on a Friday afternoon, friendo!

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Locked OTS onto cold unhurried Damon holding his ground.
shots.dialogue: I can't call it for you. Wouldn't be fair. That second brisket taco was already riding shotgun in my lower tract when I pulled up to pump two.
shots.tts: I can't call it for you. Wouldn't be fair. That second brisket taco was already riding shotgun in my lower tract when I pulled up to pump two.

shots.speaker: zach
shots.cam: Sweating tight CU of Zach trapped by pure logic.
shots.dialogue: Why am I betting on YOUR digestive system?! You didn't even open the cashews yet—just grab the pink bottle on my counter!
shots.tts: Why am I betting on YOUR digestive system?! You didn't even open the cashews yet—just grab the pink bottle on my counter!

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Stone-faced tight CU of Damon pressing harder.
shots.dialogue: No medicine. Everything in my race nutrition is weighed to the gram. Call it, friend.
shots.tts: No medicine. Everything in my race nutrition is weighed to the gram. Call it, friend.

shots.speaker: zach
shots.cam: Desperate wide-eyed CU of Zach giving in.
shots.dialogue: Alright... fine! Heads then! Call it heads, lock it in, and take three giant steps backward away from that magazine rack!
shots.tts: Alright... fine! Heads then! Call it heads, lock it in, and take three giant steps backward away from that magazine rack!

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Slow measured push-in onto Damon staring coldly forward across the counter.
shots.dialogue: Well done. You called heads cleanly... Unfortunately, the quarter landed tails. Keep the change on the receipt.
shots.tts: Well done. You called heads cleanly... Unfortunately, the quarter landed tails. Keep the change on the receipt.

shots.speaker: zach
shots.cam: Horrified whispered reaction CU of Zach looking down at Damon's knees.
shots.dialogue: Hold on... you got three seconds on that gasket, man! What is happening under your counter right now?!
shots.tts: Hold on... you got three seconds on that gasket, man! What is happening under your counter right now?!

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Cold fatalistic pre-eruption beat CU of Damon.
shots.dialogue: If the rule I followed brought me to this... of what use was the taco?
shots.tts: If the rule I followed brought me to this... of what use was the taco?

shots.speaker: fx
shots.cam: Static wide Texaco counter shot: Damon stands utterly deadpan while a catastrophic glossy wet torrent of brown diarrhea blasts behind his legs across the sunlit floorboards and lower door.

shots.speaker: zach
shots.cam: Post-blast MCU on numb Zach with hands resting flat on the oak counter beside an upright bottle of Pepto-Bismol.
shots.dialogue: You... didn't even blink once. Keep the cashews, keep the twenty bucks, and please don't use my mop bucket on pump two.
shots.tts: You... didn't even blink once. Keep the cashews, keep the twenty bucks, and please don't use my mop bucket on pump two.

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Ice-cold parting CU of Damon staring coldly forward with hands lowered out of frame.
shots.dialogue: Don't put that quarter in your pocket. Otherwise it gets washed in the sink like everything else. Call it.
shots.tts: Don't put that quarter in your pocket. Otherwise it gets washed in the sink like everything else. Call it.
